name: respira-for-wordpress
description: Read and edit a live WordPress site in its page builder's own format: Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg and 14 more. An edit to a published page lands on a draft copy a person approves, and every write saves a snapshot first. Needs the Respira plugin on the site; there is a free trial.

WORDPRESS_URL.title: WordPress site URL
WORDPRESS_URL.description: The site address exactly as in WordPress Settings, General, https included. Example: https://example.com

WORDPRESS_API_KEY.title: Respira API key
WORDPRESS_API_KEY.description: From wp-admin, Respira, Setup, or from your setup page at https://www.respira.press/dashboard/mcp. It starts with respira_.
